text:
alina: Quick heads up — after yesterday's driver/firmware roll, Xid rate dropped overall but we're seeing short spikes on a small subset of nodes. Thinking we should bump telemetry sample rate on a canary pool to correlate KV cache pressure and Xid timing. cc @sanjay @tess

sanjay: Which metrics do you want more of? ECC counts, pci-errors, sm-faults? We can add perf events too but that'll increase ingest costs.

alina: ECC/DIMM, sm_mce, Xid (16/31/37) kernel lines, power/thermal samples. Also per-request KV cache hit ratios around the Xid windows. Prefer +/-30s around event.

tess: We can enable 10s sampling on a 20-node canary in us-west-2. Also add a pre-filter to only persist samples around Xid events to keep costs sane. Does that work?

infra-bot: Deployment request accepted: increased telemetry sampling on tag=gpu-canary-usw2 for 20 nodes. Change applied at 2024-06-25T12:34Z. ETA ~2m. Logs stage to s3://redwood-telemetry/sa/1769456789/

michael: Sweet. Can someone add a quick observability pane that overlays Xid events vs KV cache size/evictions? I can prototype the dashboard if you want.

alina: Sketch: timechart overlay Xid count (right axis), KV cache entries, avg seq_len. Annotate driver and firmware revision lines so we can see deltas.

samir: Heads up — the sampling increase will bump cost estimate for that pool by ~+3%. Fine for a short canary? :money_with_wings: 

tess: :thumbsup: fine tradeoff. If we find a leading indicator we can move to event-triggered captures instead of continuous high-rate sampling.

michael: Quick grep of last night's logs shows gpu-canary-07 and -12 repeating 'Xid 31' in ~12s windows. Snip: ```[2024-06-24T22:03:11Z] gpu-canary-07 kernel: NVRM: Xid (31): PID 12345 ...````

alina: Perfect — once telemetry lands I'll run correlation and post summary. If firmware delta looks like the cause we may roll back to fw 520.56.06 on affected nodes.

ops-bot: Alerting for tag=gpu-canary-usw2 muted for 1h to reduce noise.

tess: Also can we run an A/B canary? Keep current driver+fw pinned on half, roll a candidate driver on the other half with identical workload. Want to compare Xid frequency under same load.

sanjay: Will do. Spinning candidate pool of 10 nodes with driver 535.1x and fw 520.56.08; routing 50% of canary traffic there. Posting node list once ready.

alina: Last ask: extend raw PCI/kernel logs retention for these nodes to 7d (instead of 3d) so we can do deeper dives if needed.

infra-bot: Retention override set for tag=gpu-canary-usw2 -> 7d. Confirmed.

alina: Thanks all — I'll run correlations as soon as samples are in and summarize findings. If we get a clear signal we can decide rollback vs firmware patch vs driver tweak.
